Deine 
• Aufgaben Deine Einsätze finden auf der Wohngruppe 3 statt. Du unterstützt das Team bei der ganzheitlichen Betreuung und Pflege unserer chronisch psychisch erkrankten Bewohnenden. Genauso unterstützt du unsere Bewohnenden bei der Bewältigung ihres Alltags. Deine Beobachtungen rapportierst du mündlich dem Team. Das Praktikum ist für längstens ein Jahr befristet. Dein Profil Du bist eine ausgeglichene, empathische Persönlichkeit. Du verständigst dich fliessend auf Deutsch. Deine Vorteile Über uns Mit rund 1'400 Mitarbeitenden stellen wir an unseren neun Unternehmensstandorten gut zugängliche, persönliche und wirkungsvolle psychiatrische Behandlungen und die Betreuung von erwachsenen Menschen in den Kantonen St.Gallen und Appenzell Ausserrhoden sowie im Fürstentum Liechtenstein sicher. Dokumente Praktika Folgende Unterlagen sind der Online-Bewerbung beizulegen: Bewerbungsschreiben inkl. Angaben zum gewünschten Zeitraum Lebenslauf Schul-/Arbeitszeugnisse Aktuelle Diplome Kopie des Ausländerausweises Online bewerben Wir sind digital uns setzen uns für Nachhaltigkeit ein. Wir bitten dich daher, deine Bewerbung über die Homepage hochzuladen. Bewerbungen per Post und per Email werden nicht bearbeitet. Bestätigung per E-Mail Sobald deine Bewerbung online bei uns eingegangen ist, bekommst du eine Empfangsbestätigung per E-Mail zugestellt. Wir freuen uns, dich anhand deines Dossiers kennenzulernen und prüfen, ob deine Qualifikationen, Fähigkeiten und du als Person zur ausgeschriebenen Stelle und zur Psychiatrie St.Gallen passen. Danach melden wir uns bei dir. Vorstellungsgespräch mit HR und Fachbereich Bei einem persönlichen Gespräch lernen wir uns kennen und du erfährst mehr über die Psychiatrie St.Gallen, die ausgeschriebene Stelle und die Herausforderungen. Schnuppertag Im zweiten Schritt möchten wir uns gerne ein noch besseres Bild von dir machen und gemeinsam mit dir herausfinden, ob wir zusammenpassen. Zudem hast du die Möglichkeit, dein künftiges Team kennenzulernen. Finaler Entscheid Im Anschluss an unsere Gespräche treffen wir die finale Entscheidung, die wir dir persönlich mitteilen, wobei wir auch deine Entscheidung bei dir abholen. Wenn wir uns einig sind, erstellen wir deinen Arbeitsvertrag. Vertragsabschluss In den darauffolgenden Tagen bekommst du deinen Arbeitsvertrag elektronisch zugestellt. Mit dem Vertrag erhältst du auch relevante Informationen zu deiner Anstellung und zum Einführungstag.

Descrizione I vostri incarichi si svolgeranno sul gruppo residenziale 3. Lei sostiene la squadra nella cura olistica e nella cura dei nostri residenti cronicamente malati. Allo stesso modo, sostenete i nostri residenti nel affrontare la loro vita quotidiana. Tu riferisci verbalmente le tue osservazioni alla squadra. Lo stage è limitato per un massimo di un anno.
• Requisiti - Sei una personalità empatica e equilibrata. - Comunichi fluentemente in tedesco. Cosa di Friamo Con circa 1.400 dipendenti, forniamo un trattamento psichiatrico accessibile, personale ed efficace e la cura per gli adulti nei cantoni di St.Gallen e Appenzell Ausserrhoden così come nel Principato del Liechtenstein. - Documenti Stage I seguenti documenti devono essere allegati alla domanda online: Lettera di domanda incl. Informazioni sul periodo desiderato di curriculum vitae scuola/lavoro Certificati attuali Copia della carta d'identità dello straniero - Applicare online Siamo digitali e siamo impegnati nella sostenibilità. Vi chiediamo quindi di caricare la vostra applicazione tramite la homepage. Le applicazioni per posta e per e-mail non saranno elaborate. - Conferma via e-mail Non appena la vostra domanda è stata ricevuta da noi online, riceverete una conferma della ricevuta via e-mail. Durante un'intervista personale, ci conosciamo e imparerai di più sulla psichiatria a St.Gallen, la posizione pubblicizzata e le sfide. Nel secondo passo, vorremmo ottenere un'immagine ancora migliore di voi e scoprire insieme a voi se ci adattiamo insieme. Hai anche la possibilità di conoscere la tua squadra futura. - Decisione finale Dopo le nostre discussioni, prenderemo la decisione finale, che vi diremo personalmente, e prenderemo anche la vostra decisione. Se siamo d'accordo, prepareremo il vostro contratto di lavoro. - Conclusione contrattuale Nei giorni seguenti riceverai il contratto di lavoro elettronicamente. Con il contratto, riceverete anche informazioni rilevanti sul vostro lavoro e il giorno di introduzione.

Descrizione Your assignments will take place on residential group 3. You support the team in the holistic care and care of our chronically mentally ill residents. In the same way, you support our residents in coping with their everyday life. You verbally report your observations to the team. The internship is limited for a maximum of one year.
• Requirements - You are a balanced, empathetic personality. - You communicate fluently in German. Cosa of Friamo With around 1,400 employees, we provide accessible, personal and effective psychiatric treatment and care for adults in the cantons of St.Gallen and Appenzell Ausserrhoden as well as in the Principality of Liechtenstein. - Documents Internships The following documents are to be attached to the online application: Application letter incl. Information on the desired period of curriculum vitae school/work certificates Current diplomas Copy of the foreigner’s ID card - Apply online We are digital and we are committed to sustainability. We therefore ask you to upload your application via the homepage. Applications by post and email will not be processed. - Confirmation by e-mail As soon as your application has been received by us online, you will receive a confirmation of receipt by e-mail. During a personal interview, we get to know each other and you will learn more about the psychiatry in St.Gallen, the advertised position and the challenges. In the second step, we would like to get an even better picture of you and find out together with you whether we fit together. You also have the opportunity to get to know your future team. - Final decision After our discussions, we will make the final decision, which we will tell you personally, and we will also pick up your decision. If we agree, we will draw up your employment contract. - Contract conclusion In the following days you will receive your employment contract electronically. With the contract, you will also receive relevant information about your employment and the day of introduction.

I tuoi
• Compiti Accompagni e supporti consapevolmente i nostri pazienti durante la notte. Il trattamento e la consulenza orientati all'individuo, ai bisogni e alle risorse, ad esempio sulle misure per favorire il sonno, sono nelle vostre mani. You love your profession as a nurse or health care professional and would like to make your assignments flexible? Then you are right with us. We are looking for experienced professionals from the care sector for our internal care pool, who support us on demand in the hourly wage. You accompany and care for patients with mental illnesses in the inpatient environment and contribute to their well-being as well as a stable and safe environment. - You support nursing and supervising activities according to your qualifications and take over these in compliance with the applicable quality, hygiene and safety standards. With your calm, appreciative and empathetic nature, you create trust, convey orientation and give the patient safety in challenging situations. You make an important contribution to the promotion of independence, resources and quality of life of patients in everyday life.
• Requisiti - You have completed training as a qualified nurse HF/FH or as a health care professional EFZ. - You are characterized by a high sense of responsibility, reliability and a careful working method. - You have a very good knowledge of German in words and writing and communicate in an appreciative and professional way with patients, relatives and employees. - You are flexible and ready to take on bets at short notice as well as on weekends and holidays. Your resilience, helpfulness and teamwork make you a valued support for patients and the entire treatment team. A respectful treatment of people and a strong empathy round off your profile. With around 1,400 employees, we provide accessible, personal and effective psychiatric treatment and care for adults in the cantons of St.Gallen and Appenzell Ausserrhoden as well as in the Principality of Liechtenstein at our nine company locations. - Apply online We are on the road digitally and are committed to sustainability, so we look forward to your online application via our homepage. - Confirmation by e-mail As soon as your application has been received by us online, you will receive a confirmation of receipt by e-mail. - We are happy to get to know you based on your dossier and check whether your qualifications, skills and you as a person fit the advertised position and the psychiatry St.Gallen. - Then we'll contact you. Contatto - interview with HR and department During a personal interview we get to know each other and you will learn more about the psychiatry St.Gallen, the advertised position and the challenges. In the second round we would like to get an even better picture of you and find out together with you whether we fit together. You will also have the opportunity to get to know your future team. You will receive a telephone confirmation from us if we decide for you after the second interview and ask you if you are still convinced of us. - If we agree, we will draw up your contract. - The contract In the following days we will send you the contract by post in double. - The contract also provides you with relevant information about your employment. Between the acceptance of the job and the first working day, you as a new employee can already access relevant internal information. - So you can get a differentiated picture of the company and already prepare for the job. - First working day On the first day you can expect an onboarding in your new team and with other colleagues. - You set up at the new workplace and get an overview of your next tasks. - You also get your individual introduction plan, which helps you to find your way around quickly.

Für die Eröffnung unserer neuen forensisch-psychiatrischen Station mit mittlerer Sicherheitsstufe suchen wir eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit aus Polizei, Justizvollzug, Forensik oder einem vergleichbaren sicherheitsrelevanten Umfeld. In dieser verantwortungsvollen Schlüsselrolle leitest du den Sicherheitsbereich fachlich und operativ und gestaltest gemeinsam mit deinem Team ein professionelles, sicheres und respektvolles Umfeld. Dabei verbindest du ausgeprägte Sicherheitskompetenz mit Verständnis für den Umgang mit psychisch erkrankten Menschen. Deine 
• Aufgaben Du führst dein Sicherheitsteam, baust dieses im Zuge der Eröffnung der neuen Station weiter auf und förderst die fachliche sowie persönliche Entwicklung deiner Mitarbeitenden. Mit deinem Team stellst du einen professionellen, sicheren und reibungslosen 24/7 Betrieb sicher und gewährleistest die Einhaltung aller relevanten Sicherheitsstandards. Bei besonderen Ereignissen, kritischen Vorfällen oder Krisensituationen übernimmst du die Einsatzleitung, koordinierst die notwendigen Massnahmen und sorgst für eine professionelle Lagebewältigung. Du arbeitest eng und vertrauensvoll mit der Klinikleitung, dem Pflegebereich, der Ärzteschaft sowie externen Partnerorganisationen wie Polizei, Rettungsdiensten und weiteren Behörden zusammen. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem pflegerischen Leiter Forensik, im Rahmen der PSG Sicherheitsrelevante Konzepte und Richtlinien weiter und stellst die Umsetzung in deinem Bereich sicher. Durch die Durchführung von Risikoanalysen, Sicherheitsbeurteilungen und geeigneten Präventionsmassnahmen erkennst du potenzielle Gefährdungen frühzeitig und leitest wirksame Massnahmen zur Risikominimierung ein. Du planst, organisierst und leitest regelmässige Schulungen sowie praxisnahe Trainings, um die Handlungssicherheit und Fachkompetenz der Mitarbeitenden nachhaltig zu stärken. Beim Aufbau der neuen forensisch-psychiatrischen Station bringst du deine Expertise aktiv ein und gestaltest Prozesse, Sicherheitsstandards sowie organisatorische Abläufe massgeblich mit. Dein Profil Du verfügst über eine angeschlossene Berufsausbildung sowie eine anerkannte Ausbildung im Sicherheitsbereich (vorzugsweise VSSU, Sicherheitsfachfrau/-mann mit eidg. Fachausweis oder vergleichbare Qualifikation) und du kennst die 
• Anforderungen sicherheitsrelevanter Organisationen aus der Praxis. Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer Sicherheitsfunktion mit Führungsverantwortung ermöglicht es dir, Teams professionell zu führen und auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen die richtigen Prioritäten zu setzen. Im Notfall-, Lage- und Krisenmanagement bringst du fundierte Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrung mit und behältst auch unter Druck den Überblick. Durch dein professionelles, ruhiges und sicheres Auftreten handelst du auch in herausfordernden Situationen besonnen und lösungsorientiert. Der respektvolle und klare Umgang mit psychisch erkrankten Menschen ist für dich selbstverständlich, wobei du auf professionelle Deeskalation und eine wertschätzende Kommunikation setzt. Mit deiner souveränen Kommunikationsweise triffst du fundierte Entscheidungen, übernimmst Verantwortung und schaffst Vertrauen bei Mitarbeitenden und Partnern. Eine strukturierte, selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise zeichnet dich ebenso aus wie ein hohes Mass an Integrität und Verantwortungsbewusstsein. Die Möglichkeit, beim Aufbau einer neuen forensisch-psychiatrischen Station aktiv mitzuwirken und nachhaltige Strukturen mitzugestalten, motiviert dich besonders. Deine Vorteile Über uns Mit rund 1'400 Mitarbeitenden stellen wir an unseren neun Unternehmensstandorten gut zugängliche, persönliche und wirkungsvolle psychiatrische Behandlungen und die Betreuung von erwachsenen Menschen in den Kantonen St.Gallen und Appenzell Ausserrhoden sowie im Fürstentum Liechtenstein sicher. Online bewerben Wir sind digital unterwegs und setzen uns für Nachhaltigkeit ein, daher freuen wir uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung über unsere Homepage. Bestätigung per E-Mail Sobald deine Bewerbung online bei uns eingegangen ist, bekommst du eine Empfangsbestätigung per E-Mail zugestellt. Wir freuen uns, dich anhand deines Dossiers kennenzulernen und prüfen, ob deine Qualifikationen, Fähigkeiten und du als Person zur ausgeschriebenen Stelle und zur Psychiatrie St.Gallen passen. Danach melden wir uns bei dir. Vorstellungsgespräch mit HR und Fachbereich Bei einem persönlichen Gespräch lernen wir uns kennen und du erfährst mehr über die Psychiatrie St.Gallen, die ausgeschriebene Stelle und die Herausforderungen. Einladung zum zweiten Gespräch In der zweiten Runde möchten wir uns gerne ein noch besseres Bild von Ihnen machen und gemeinsam mit Ihnen herausfinden, ob wir zusammenpassen. Zudem erhalten Sie die Möglichkeit, Ihr künftiges Team kennenzulernen. Mündliche Zusage Sie erhalten von uns eine telefonische Zusage, wenn wir uns nach dem zweiten Gespräch für Sie entscheiden und fragen bei Ihnen nach, ob auch Sie weiterhin von uns überzeugt sind. Wenn wir uns einig sind, erstellen wir Ihren Vertrag. Der Vetrag In den darauffolgenden Tagen senden wir Ihnen per Post den Vertrag im Doppel zu. Mit dem Vertrag erhalten Sie auch relevante Informationen zu Ihrer Anstellung. Preboarding Zwischen der Annahme der Stelle und dem ersten Arbeitstag können Sie als neue Mitarbeiterin oder neuer Mitarbeiter bereits auf relevante interne Informationen zugreifen. So können Sie sich ein differenziertes Bild des Unternehmens machen und sich bereits auf den Job vorbereiten. Erster Arbeitstag Am ersten Tag erwartet Sie ein Onboarding in Ihrem neuen Team und mit weiteren Kolleginnen und Kollegen. Sie richten sich am neuen Arbeitsplatz ein und schaffen sich einen Überblick über Ihre nächsten 
• Aufgaben. Zudem erhalten Sie Ihren individuellen Einführungsplan, der Ihnen dabei hilft, sich schnell zurechtzufinden.

Per l'apertura della nostra nuova stazione psichiatrica forense con un livello di sicurezza intermedio, stiamo cercando un leader esperto della polizia, della prigione, della scientifica o un ambiente comparabile di sicurezza-rilevante. In questo ruolo chiave responsabile, gestirai l'area di sicurezza professionalmente e operativamente e formerai un ambiente professionale, sicuro e rispettoso insieme al tuo team. Combina una forte competenza di sicurezza con la comprensione di trattare con le persone mentalmente malate. Guida il tuo team di sicurezza, costruiscilo ulteriormente nel corso dell'apertura della nuova stazione e promuovi lo sviluppo professionale e personale dei tuoi dipendenti. Con il tuo team, garantisci un funzionamento professionale, sicuro e regolare 24 ore su 24, 7 giorni su 7 e garantisci la conformità a tutti gli standard di sicurezza rilevanti. In eventi speciali, incidenti critici o situazioni di crisi, si prende il controllo della gestione operativa, coordinare le misure necessarie e garantire una gestione professionale della situazione. Si lavora a stretto contatto e con fiducia con la gestione clinica, l'area di cura, la professione medica e le organizzazioni partner esterne come la polizia, i servizi di emergenza e altre autorità. Insieme al direttore di allattamento forense, svilupperai concetti e linee guida rilevanti per la sicurezza nell'ambito del PSG e garantirai l'implementazione nella tua zona. Effettuando analisi dei rischi, valutazioni di sicurezza e adeguate misure di prevenzione, si identificano potenziali pericoli in una fase iniziale e si avviano efficaci misure di mitigazione dei rischi. Pianifichi, organizzi e conduci sessioni di formazione regolari e sessioni di formazione pratiche per rafforzare in modo sostenibile l'affidabilità e la competenza dei dipendenti. Quando creerai la nuova stazione psichiatrica forense, contribuirai attivamente alla tua esperienza e alla forma significativa dei processi, degli standard di sicurezza e dei processi organizzativi. Hai una formazione professionale associata e una formazione riconosciuta nel settore della sicurezza (preferibilmente VSSU, specialista di sicurezza con un certificato federale o una qualifica simile) e conosci i requisiti delle organizzazioni di sicurezza-rilevanti dalla pratica. Diversi anni di esperienza in una funzione di sicurezza con responsabilità di leadership ti permettono di guidare i team professionalmente e impostare le giuste priorità anche in situazioni difficili. In caso di emergenza, gestione della situazione e della crisi, si porterà una conoscenza approfondita e un'esperienza pratica e anche mantenere una panoramica sotto pressione. Attraverso il vostro aspetto professionale, tranquillo e sicuro, si agisce anche con calma e orientata alla soluzione in situazioni difficili. Il trattamento rispettoso e chiaro delle persone mentalmente ammalate è una questione naturalmente per voi, concentrandosi sulla de-escalation professionale e la comunicazione apprezzativa. Con il vostro modo sovrano di comunicare, prendete decisioni informate, assumete la responsabilità e create la fiducia tra dipendenti e partner. Un modo di lavorare strutturato, indipendente e affidabile ti distingue così come un alto grado di integrità e senso di responsabilità. L'opportunità di partecipare attivamente alla costruzione di una nuova stazione forense-psichiatrica e di modellare strutture sostenibili vi motiva in particolare. Con circa 1.400 dipendenti nelle nostre nove sedi aziendali, forniamo trattamenti psichiatrici accessibili, personali ed efficaci e cura per gli adulti nei cantoni di St.Gallen e Appenzell Ausserrhoden così come nel Principato del Liechtenstein. Allora ti contatteremo. Durante un'intervista personale ci conosceremo e imparerete di più sulla psichiatria St.Gallen, la posizione pubblicizzata e le sfide. For the opening of our new forensic-psychiatric station with an intermediate security level, we are looking for an experienced leader from the police, prison, forensics or a comparable security-relevant environment. In this responsible key role, you will manage the security area professionally and operationally and shape a professional, safe and respectful environment together with your team. You combine strong safety competence with understanding of dealing with mentally ill people. You lead your security team, build it up further in the course of the opening of the new station and promote the professional and personal development of your employees. With your team, you ensure professional, safe and smooth 24/7 operation and ensure compliance with all relevant safety standards. In special events, critical incidents or crisis situations, you take over the operational management, coordinate the necessary measures and ensure a professional management of the situation. You work closely and trustfully with the clinic management, the nursing area, the medical profession as well as external partner organizations such as the police, emergency services and other authorities. Together with the nursing director forensics, you will develop security-relevant concepts and guidelines within the framework of the PSG and ensure implementation in your area. By carrying out risk analyses, safety assessments and appropriate prevention measures, you identify potential hazards at an early stage and initiate effective risk mitigation measures. You plan, organize and lead regular training sessions as well as practical training sessions in order to sustainably strengthen the reliability and expertise of employees. When setting up the new forensic-psychiatric station, you will actively contribute your expertise and significantly shape processes, security standards and organizational processes. You have an associated vocational training as well as a recognized training in the security sector (preferably VSSU, security specialist with a federal certificate or comparable qualification) and you know the requirements of security-relevant organizations from practice. Several years of experience in a security function with leadership responsibility enables you to lead teams professionally and set the right priorities even in demanding situations. In emergency, situational and crisis management, you will bring in-depth knowledge and practical experience and also keep an overview under pressure. Through your professional, calm and secure appearance, you also act calmly and solution-oriented in challenging situations. The respectful and clear treatment of mentally ill people is a matter of course for you, focusing on professional de-escalation and appreciative communication. With your sovereign way of communication, you make informed decisions, take responsibility and create trust among employees and partners. A structured, independent and reliable way of working distinguishes you as well as a high degree of integrity and sense of responsibility. The opportunity to actively participate in the construction of a new forensic-psychiatric station and to shape sustainable structures motivates you in particular. With around 1,400 employees at our nine company locations, we provide accessible, personal and effective psychiatric treatments and care for adults in the cantons of St.Gallen and Appenzell Ausserrhoden as well as in the Principality of Liechtenstein. We are happy to get to know you based on your dossier and check whether your qualifications, skills and you as a person fit the advertised position and the psychiatry St.Gallen. Then we will contact you. During a personal interview we get to know each other and you will learn more about the psychiatry St.Gallen, the advertised position and the challenges. In the second round we would like to get an even better picture of you and find out together with you whether we fit together. You will also have the opportunity to get to know your future team. You will receive a telephone confirmation from us if we decide for you after the second interview and ask you if you are still convinced of us. If we agree, we will draw up your contract. Pour ouvrir notre nouveau service de psychiatrie médico-légale à sécurité moyenne, nous recherchons un leader expérimenté provenant de la police, des services correctionnels, de la médecine légale ou d'un environnement comparable lié à la sécurité. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration et en toute confiance avec la direction de la clinique, le service des soins infirmiers, le corps médical et les organisations partenaires externes telles que la police, les services d'urgence et d'autres autorités. En collaboration avec le chef infirmier de la médecine légale, vous développerez des concepts et des directives relatifs à la sécurité au sein du PSG et veillerez à leur mise en œuvre dans votre région. En effectuant des analyses de risques, des évaluations de sécurité et des mesures de prévention appropriées, vous pouvez identifier à temps les menaces potentielles et prendre des mesures efficaces pour minimiser les risques. Ti stabilisci nel tuo nuovo posto di lavoro e ottieni una panoramica dei tuoi prossimi compiti. Riceverai anche il tuo piano di introduzione individuale, che ti aiuterà a orientarti rapidamente.

Descrizione Do you want to live medicine holistically and accompany people in challenging life situations? In our interdisciplinary team, you will play an important role at the interface between somatic and psychiatric care. You will help to optimally care for and promote the physical health of our patients. Mansioni - You will be responsible for the internal and general medical care of our inpatients. - You carry out medical examinations on symptomatic patients, determine the indication for further examinations, make diagnoses and initiate appropriate treatments. - You assess and treat somatic comorbidities in a psychiatric context and help to optimize somatic medication. - You work closely with psychiatrists, psychologists as well as the nursing and therapist team. - You support the psychiatrists in interpreting ECG and laboratory findings. - You carefully document the treatments and actively participate in interdisciplinary case discussions. 
• Requisiti - You have a specialist title in general internal medicine or a comparable qualification. - You are interested in working in a psychiatric environment and appreciate a holistic treatment approach. - You work independently, responsibly and at the same time enjoy working in an interprofessional team. - You are characterized by high social skills and an appreciative approach to patients. - You maintain an overview even in demanding situations and make well-founded medical decisions. - You have very good knowledge of spoken and written German. 
• Cosa offriamo - About us: With around 1,400 employees at our nine company locations, we ensure easily accessible, personal and effective psychiatric treatment and care for adults in the cantons of St.Gallen and Appenzell Ausserrhoden as well as in the Principality of Liechtenstein. - Apply online: We are digital and committed to sustainability, so we look forward to receiving your online application via our homepage. - Confirmation by email: As soon as we have received your application online, you will receive a confirmation of receipt by email. We look forward to getting to know you based on your dossier and checking whether your qualifications, skills and you as a person fit the advertised position and St.Gallen Psychiatry. You will also have the opportunity to get to know your future team. - Oral confirmation: You will receive a telephone confirmation from us if we decide in favor of you after the second conversation and ask you whether you are still convinced of us. If we agree, we will create your contract. - The contract: In the following days we will send you the contract in duplicate by post. With the contract you will also receive relevant information about your employment. - Preboarding: As a new employee, you can access relevant internal information between accepting the position and your first day of work. This way you can get a differentiated picture of the company and prepare for the job. - First day of work: On the first day you can expect onboarding in your new team and with other colleagues. You settle into your new workplace and get an overview of your next tasks. You will also receive your individual introduction plan, which will help you quickly find your way around.

• Requisiti - Hai completato la formazione come specialista infermieristico HF / FH (per la formazione all'estero è richiesto il riconoscimento SRK o un PreCheck positivo) - Le tue conoscenze della lingua tedesca corrispondono almeno al livello C1 - Idealmente hai esperienza professionale in psichiatria. - Le tue buone competenze informatiche facilitano il tuo lavoro amministrativo. Chi siamo - Con circa 1.400 collaboratori, nelle nostre nove sedi aziendali garantiamo cure e assistenza psichiatrica per adulti facilmente accessibili, personali ed efficaci per gli adulti nei cantoni di San Gallo e Appenzello Esterno nonché nel Principato del Liechtenstein. Processo di selezione - Candidati online: Siamo digitali e impegnati nella sostenibilità, quindi non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura online tramite la nostra home page. - Conferma via e-mail: non appena avremo ricevuto la tua candidatura online, riceverai una conferma di ricezione via e-mail. Non vediamo l'ora di conoscerti sulla base del tuo dossier e di verificare se le tue qualifiche, competenze e te come persona sono adatti alla posizione pubblicizzata e alla Psichiatria di San Gallo. Ti contatteremo quindi. - Colloquio con le risorse umane e il dipartimento: durante un colloquio personale ci conosceremo e scoprirete di più sulla psichiatria di San Gallo, sulla posizione pubblicizzata e sulle sfide. - Invito al secondo colloquio: nel secondo turno vorremmo avere un'immagine ancora migliore di te e lavorare con te per scoprire se siamo adatti. Avrai anche l'opportunità di conoscere la tua futura squadra. - Conferma orale: riceverai una nostra conferma telefonica se decidiamo a tuo favore dopo la seconda conversazione e ti chiederemo se sei ancora convinto di noi. Se siamo d'accordo, creeremo il tuo contratto. - Il contratto: Nei giorni successivi vi invieremo per posta il contratto in duplice copia. Con il contratto riceverai anche informazioni rilevanti sul tuo impiego. - Preboarding: come nuovo dipendente, puoi accedere alle informazioni interne rilevanti tra l'accettazione della posizione e il tuo primo giorno di lavoro. In questo modo puoi ottenere un quadro differenziato dell'azienda e prepararti per il lavoro. - Primo giorno di lavoro: il primo giorno puoi aspettarti l'onboarding nel tuo nuovo team e con altri colleghi. Ti stabilisci nel tuo nuovo posto di lavoro e ottieni una panoramica dei tuoi prossimi compiti. Riceverai anche il tuo piano di introduzione individuale, che ti aiuterà a orientarti rapidamente.

Mansioni - You create a stable and supportive everyday life for our residents together with a motivated team. - You maintain an overview even in challenging situations and act prudently and professionally. - As part of the caregiver work, you develop individual goals and strategies. - You contribute your ideas and actively shape the further development of our living group - After a thorough introduction, you also take on day-to-day responsibility. - If you are interested, you can take on the vocational training of students/learners or get trained to do so. - If you are interested and suitable, it is possible to take on the role of deputy group leader. 
• Requisiti - You have completed training as a HF / FH nursing specialist (for foreign training, SRK recognition or a positive PreCheck is required) - Your German language skills correspond to at least level C1 - You ideally have professional experience in psychiatry. - Your good computer skills make your administrative work easier. Chi siamo - With around 1,400 employees, we ensure easily accessible, personal and effective psychiatric treatment and care for adults in the cantons of St.Gallen and Appenzell Ausserrhoden as well as in the Principality of Liechtenstein at our nine company locations. Processo di selezione - Apply online: We are digital and committed to sustainability, so we look forward to receiving your online application via our homepage. - Confirmation by email: As soon as we have received your application online, you will receive a confirmation of receipt by email. We look forward to getting to know you based on your dossier and checking whether your qualifications, skills and you as a person fit the advertised position and St.Gallen Psychiatry. We will then contact you. - Interview with HR and department: During a personal interview, we will get to know each other and you will find out more about St.Gallen Psychiatry, the advertised position and the challenges. - Invitation to the second interview: In the second round, we would like to get an even better picture of you and work with you to find out whether we are a good fit. You will also have the opportunity to get to know your future team. - Oral confirmation: You will receive a telephone confirmation from us if we decide in favor of you after the second conversation and ask you whether you are still convinced of us. If we agree, we will create your contract. - The contract: In the following days we will send you the contract in duplicate by post. With the contract you will also receive relevant information about your employment. - Preboarding: As a new employee, you can access relevant internal information between accepting the position and your first day of work. This way you can get a differentiated picture of the company and prepare for the job. - First day of work: On the first day you can expect onboarding in your new team and with other colleagues. You settle into your new workplace and get an overview of your next tasks. You will also receive your individual introduction plan, which will help you quickly find your way around.
